responsibility: Implements global RTL constant and copy propagation on top of GCSE-style dataflow. It builds a hash table of assignment expressions and implicit sets, computes local and global availability information across basic blocks, propagates constant or register-copy values into later uses and conditional jumps, handles CFG changes such as edge splitting and unreachable blocks, and records propagation statistics; this is the dedicated propagation pass in the GCSE subsystem rather than the PRE or hoisting engine itself.
